title: Capability
description:
Guiding question: What can Please do?

A capability describes a distinct ability of Please, independent of its technical implementation. It captures the agreed product scope rather than implementation progress. Examples include executing deterministic checks, importing external rulesets, and integrating LLM providers.

id.description: Permanent, unique identifier. IDs must never be reused.

name.description: Short, descriptive name of the capability.

description.description: Describes what Please must be capable of, using complete sentences.
examples: Please executes deterministic checks at configured execution points and records their results.

obsolete.description: Marks a capability as historical and no longer part of the current product specification. Omit this property for active capabilities.
